adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` the `onError` handler builds `message` via a template literal: ``const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;``. Template literals always produce a string, so `message` will be truthy even when `err.data?.code` is `undefined` (e.g., resulting in `"undefined: Failed to fetch"`). Therefore the fallback `|| t("unable_to_add_guests")` is effectively dead code and users can see confusing `undefined:` prefixes on network/unknown errors.
